title: Outer Type Severi-Brauer Schemes
summary: We introduce the notion of a lowered flag of $\mathcal{O}$--modules in order to define a sheaf of flags of ideals isomorphic to the sheaf of parabolic subgroups for the general linear group $\mathbf{GL}_{1,\mathcal{A}}$ of an Azumaya algebra over a general scheme $S$. This notion is extended to the outer type $A_n$ case and we define a suitable sheaf of flags of ideals isomorphic to the sheaf of parabolic subgroups for a unitary group over $S$. When the group is suitably split these are related to flags of submodules in a vector bundle or in a vector bundle with hermitian form, respectively.…
